query:
UPDATE favorite f
            SET sort_order = x.ord::float8 - 1, updated_at = now()
            FROM UNNEST($2::text[], $3::text[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS x(entity_type, entity_id, ord)
            WHERE f.user_id = $1
              AND f.entity_type = x.entity_type
              AND f.entity_id = x.entity_id
